title: Work orders file
description: The work orders the Governor (orchestrator) found in one artifact, and each order's result: the checkpoint that lets an interrupted run continue without calling the Governor again (ADR-0018, handoff 007, 3.5). Stored as <memory>/work-orders/<artifact ID>.json. Code owns every field; the evidence and labels are verified artifact text. Never sent to an LLM provider.

artifact_id.description: The Artifact Ledger entry these work orders come from.

run_id.description: The run that called the Governor. A held Ledger entry with this run_id, followed by a release, releases this file.

governor.description: The Governor run whose reply was accepted.

definitions.description: The register definition versions in the Governor's prompt, in register order.

max_items.description: KA_GOVERNOR_MAX_ITEMS when the file was written. The hold check uses this value, not the current setting.

orders.description: Every work order, numbered from 1 in the order their earliest quote appears in the artifact.

timestamp.description: UTC, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, as in records and the Ledger.

label.description: Placeholder built by code from the first quote: at most 60 characters, plus ... when cut.

evidence.description: The Governor's quotes, checked against the artifact, in the Governor's order.

state.description: pending: not drafted yet. recorded: produced a record (final). rejected: its last draft or comparison was rejected; a rerun drafts it again. not-routed: its register has no Registrar yet (final).

produced.description: The Ledger produced item, without work_order. Present only when recorded.

rejected.description: Ledger rejected items for this order, without work_order, each with its run_id. Append-only.
